# Library notices from pinned source inputs

These unmodified files were extracted from the exact Git revisions or source
archive checksum in `third_party/deps.lock.json`. `provenance.json` records origin
and checksums. This covers SDL2, OpenAL Soft, mpg123, libsndfile, and libxmp.
Nested license texts are retained conservatively; their inclusion is not a claim
that every optional component is compiled into the app.

This is not a grant for Unreal Tournament, FMOD, or UTP as a whole. Matching these
source revisions to the released binaries, other per-file notices, and complete
source/relinking delivery still require review. Do not label this collection a
complete compliance audit.
